functionalities: - At the start of the game, all :Card:s are face-down and their positions are randomly shuffled.
- :Player: can flip a :Card: face-up by clicking on it.
- If :Player: flips two :Card:s with matching symbols, both :Card:s remain face-up and are marked as matched.
- If :Player: flips two :Card:s that do not match, both :Card:s flip back face-down after a short delay (1 second).
- :Player: cannot flip more than two unmatched :Card:s at a time, and cannot click already-matched :Card:s.
- :App: tracks and displays the number of moves :Player: has made.
- :App: displays a congratulations message when all pairs have been matched, showing the total number of moves taken.
- :Player: can restart the game at any time by clicking a "New Game" button, which reshuffles the :Card:s and resets the move counter.
